name: immich-power-tools
description: Unofficial Immich client for advanced library management. Features include bulk people management, smart face merge, location enrichment, album discovery, library analytics, natural language search, and bulk date adjustment. Connects to your Immich server via API and directly to the PostgreSQL database for advanced operations. Must be on the same Docker network as immich-server and immich-vectorchord-db.

paths.name: Path: Data
paths.description: Persistent data directory for Power Tools.

variables.name: IMMICH_URL
variables.description: Internal Immich server URL. Uses container name on immich_internal network.

variables.name: IMMICH_API_KEY
variables.description: Immich API key with ALL permissions. Create in Immich: Account Icon → Account Settings → API Keys.

variables.name: --- Database ---
variables.description: PostgreSQL connection. Must match your immich-vectorchord-db configuration.

variables.name: DB_HOST
variables.description: Database container name (must match your DB container on immich_internal).

variables.name: --- Advanced (AI Search) ---
variables.description: Optional: Enable natural language search via AI provider (OpenAI, Ollama, etc.). No personal data is sent - only search query text.

variables.name: EXTERNAL_IMMICH_URL
variables.description: External Immich URL for links in the Power Tools UI (e.g. https://photos.example.com). Leave empty to use IMMICH_URL.

variables.name: AI_API_KEY
variables.description: AI provider API key for natural language search (e.g. OpenAI key).

variables.name: AI_BASE_URL
variables.description: AI provider base URL. OpenAI: https://api.openai.com/v1, Ollama: http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1

variables.name: AI_MODEL
variables.description: AI model name. Examples: gpt-4o-mini, llama-3.1-8b-instant
